acceptance: Reproduce on develop: second `--force datagen` run against existing TPC-H SF0.01 data skips generation
`--force datagen` and `--force all` regenerate TPC-H data (and other dbgen/dsdgen-backed benchmarks that share the path, e.g. TPC-DS), confirmed by log and file mtimes
Runs without --force still reuse valid existing data
Unit or integration test that fails without the fix
description: With existing valid TPC-H data, `benchbox run --benchmark tpch --force datagen` still logs "Skipping data generation (existing data is valid)" from the dbgen generator. The force flag reaches the platform adapter as force_recreate (fixed separately), but not the data generator. Suspected cause: `BenchmarkOrchestrator._get_benchmark_instance` in `benchbox/cli/orchestrator.py` only forwards `force_regenerate` when the benchmark registers that option, and TPC-H likely does not.
